# EasyMove Elite

> Premium white-glove moving company serving Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties in South Florida. Founder-led by Eugene Romanov since 2021. Specialists in high-rise and condo moves, fine art, long-distance relocation, office moves, and packing services. Licensed and fully insured. Russian-speaking crew available.

## Pricing

- Local move (2 movers): $99/hour, 3-hour minimum
- Local move (3 movers): $139/hour, 3-hour minimum
- Truck fee: from $79
- Studio apartment (typical): $376–$496
- 2-bedroom apartment (typical): $525–$705
- Long-distance moves: from $1,200, dedicated truck, no shared loads
- International moves: from $4,500, Miami-side packing/loading + freight forwarder coordination
- Fine art and specialty items: quoted individually
- Storage: from $200/month, climate-controlled

## Common Questions

### How much does a local move cost in South Florida?
Local moves are billed hourly: $99/hour for 2 movers or $139/hour for 3 movers, with a 3-hour minimum. Truck fee starts at $79. A studio typically runs $376–$496; a 2-bedroom runs $525–$705. You receive a written estimate before booking — no surprise fees on move day.

### Do you provide a Certificate of Insurance (COI) for condo buildings?
Yes. We issue COIs within 24 hours of your confirmed move date, addressed to your building management exactly as required. COI is free.

### How long does a move from Miami to Fort Lauderdale take?
A standard local move from Miami to Fort Lauderdale takes 3–5 hours total including loading, transport, and unloading.

### Do you speak Russian?
Yes. Our coordinator and most of our crew speak Russian fluently. Мы говорим по-русски.

### Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. EasyMove Elite is fully licensed and insured. We carry general liability and cargo insurance. COI available on request.

### How far in advance should I book?
We recommend 5–10 days for weekend moves and 2–5 days for weekday moves. Same-week availability is often possible — call to check.

### What is your cancellation policy?
Cancellations made more than 48 hours before your move are always free. We don't charge deposits.
